notes.title: The wire V2.0 incoming! Classic game with VR experience. Ready for a brand new cool adventure? Set off NOW!
notes.content:
1.	Two new modes: Training and Challenge
Training: Access to all stages with no Life limit. Players can practice their skills in the stages. No points, no rank.
Challenge: 15 lives for each time. Players win points and compete on the global rank.
2.	Respawn Havens: In a single challenge, if a player passes a respawn haven, he/she can revive at the haven after he/she dies.
3.	Stage modification: Adapted to a 2.3 x 2.3 space with modified stage contents.
4.	Newbie guides available: Players can learn controls of the game in the beginning.
5.	Support Chinese and English languages switch in offline environment.
6.	Art style uniformed and UI modified.
